corpus_note: The /legal_sources/ folder was not present in this project at build time. No official text has been ingested. Every record in this legal_engine/ directory is therefore PROVISIONAL and carries provenance = PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED. The application surfaces this state in the UI and in every generated report. Verbatim legal text (exact_requirement) is deliberately null everywhere — it must be populated from the official documents, never from model memory.
